facts.fact: Adwave states that generating an ad with its tool produces a broadcast-ready commercial in about 2 minutes.

facts.fact: In the article's example, a small business owner who gives up on DIY video editing might hire someone for $500.

facts.fact: In the article's example, a small business owner who tries to learn video editing software may watch 3 hours of tutorials before still being unable to change a font.
The Adwave article was published on May 5, 2025.
Adwave says it makes TV advertising accessible for small businesses, starting at $30 a day.
facts.quote: Adwave makes TV advertising accessible for small businesses, starting at just $30 a day.

facts.fact: Adwave says customers can reach audiences on more than 100 premium streaming channels.
facts.quote: reach customers on 100+ premium streaming channels.
